title: Sibuyan residents file complaint vs council over mining project

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Five residents of San Fernando town on Sibuyan Island have filed a verified administrative complaint against their municipal council before the Romblon Provincial Board over council proceedings that led to the endorsement of a mining project on the environmentally critical island. The complaint, filed on Thursday (September 24), seeks an investigation into the proceedings of the Sangguniang Bayan of San Fernando concerning Resolution No. 297, Series of 2026, which granted a municipal endorsement of Altai Philippines Mining Corp. (APMC) mine venture. READ: House probe sought into Altai Mining operations in Sibuyan Island The municipal council had subsequently adopted Resolution […]...
